## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sree Annai Catering Service?
10/2, Pillayarkoil Street, Padikuppam (Padikuppam Road), Anna Nagar West Extn., Chennai 600 107 (Near Kalyan Jewellers, Mogappair East).

### What facilities does Sree Annai Catering Service have?
Pure vegetarian catering, Morning & lunch menus, Evening & dinner menus, Seer batchanam, Nadhaswaram party, Janavasam car, Reception backdrops, Light & Carnatic music, Thamboola bags, Vegetable carving, Reception girls, Welcome dolls, Flower decoration, Manapen alangaram, Photo & video, Water fountain.

### Is the food vegetarian?
Yes. Sree Annai Catering serves high-class pure vegetarian food.

### Do you arrange more than food?
Yes — nadhaswaram, janavasam car, reception backdrops, music, thamboola bags, vegetable carving, reception girls, welcome dolls, photography and video, and more.
